data.desc: BBSI (NASDAQ: BBSI) is a professional employer organization (PEO) and business management solutions provider that combines human resources outsourcing with professional management consulting to help business owners strengthen their operations. BBSI's services include payroll processing, employee benefits, workers' compensation coverage, risk management and workplace safety programs, and human resource administration. BBSI works with more than 8,100 PEO clients across all 50 states.
